name: @suisui/step-catalog
description: Native, structured step catalog: static discovery and analysis of Playwright BDD step definitions for SuiSui.

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.build:esm: tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node scripts/create-package-json.js module dist/esm
scripts.build:cjs: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/create-package-json.js commonjs dist/cjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
